parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The application ID. Default value: **app-1000000**. For more information, see [Multiple applications](~~113600~~).

parameters.name: IdentityName
parameters.description:
The identity name.

- If IdentityType is set to RamUser, specify the Resource Access Management (RAM) user ID.
- If IdentityType is set to RamRole, specify the role name.

parameters.name: IdentityType
parameters.description:
The identity type. Valid values:
- **RamUser**: Resource Access Management (RAM) user.
- **RamRole**: RAM role.
